alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A staircase room. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a navy one on the right. The black one says nice jacket! The navy one looks down and says this old thing? The black one insists no, it's great, and the navy one smiles and says you look great too. Finally the black one says thank you! and both settle back exactly as they started, so the film repeats without a cut. The text stays: me and a compliment I can't take.
